claims: The Artemis II mission launched from Launch Pad 39B at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission lifted off on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission was powered by the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The launch site of the Artemis II mission is Kennedy Space Center, Florida, LC-39B.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission to circumnavigate the Moon with four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed mission to the Moon since 1972.
The Artemis II mission is the second in the Artemis program.
The Artemis II mission is the first in the Artemis program to carry human crew
